audience: agencies and project teams that run client workspaces and track time in Kantata OX

useCases.title: Check open workspaces and their due dates
useCases.text: List the workspaces the token can see, then read one workspace's dates, status and participants.

useCases.title: Review open tasks for the week
useCases.text: List tasks filtered by workspace, assignee or due date, then read one task's description and checklist.

useCases.title: Check who logged time last month
useCases.text: List time entries by workspace, user or date range, and check the status of timesheet submissions.

useCases.title: Create a task or log time
useCases.text: Create a task in a workspace, or log time against a task. Each call creates a new record.
